annotations.text:
REVISED against design/07 — six independent reviews.
Spec changes this forced (DESIGN.md): a `rule` token at 3.35:1 for every line that carries meaning, because `hairline` is 1.34:1 and was carrying every state; a `data` register at 13px tabular sentence case, because §6 had no register for a figure column and micro-caption had absorbed 56 applications including the user's own name; §9's "selection as weave density" corrected, since §2 already gives density to corroboration.

Disclosure is a line quality on the plate's header band, now drawn in `rule` rather than an invisible hairline. Grants are whole-record, so it is a property of the record — a per-chapter mark would be identical on every row.
The readout under the figure now counts the public page too. It previously said "2 parties can read this" while a search-indexed page was live, under-reporting exposure by the entire internet.

Provenance is now in words on the worker's own rows, not only on the page employers read. Two reviewers found the same inversion independently.
Verified rows are `.rigid` and do not compress under the thumb; unverified rows are `.press` and do. §7 says rigidity is how permanence is expressed, and it had been dead code in all nine files.

No ordinal. Four reviewers independently read "Step 1 of 6" as a rating of a person, on the panel an employer receives, on an instrument imprint/README.md §7.5 records as untested for inter-rater agreement. The anchor sentence is the level; the caveat is stated on the surface rather than in a document.
Every axis the figure carries is now also a plain 44px control, because five concentric zones across 320px cannot each reach 44px and the figure was the only way in.

The resting state is now visible: the scribe is a class added on open and removed when it finishes. Previously the figure's rest state was `stroke-dashoffset:1` and it was revealed only by the animation's fill, so any environment that suppressed animation rendered it permanently blank.
Reduced motion now zeroes delays as well as durations — the ceremony had been collapsing into a 600ms staggered flicker rather than an instant state change.

The landing now resolves to "signed, nobody else has agreed yet" and the single-party weave. It previously produced corroboration from one attestation, which record-schema.md §2 forbids — the product's highest-attention moment was teaching an impossible state transition.
Timing brought back inside §10's 1080ms budget; it had run 1330ms while the phase change fired at 1080, snapping the last passes mid-draw.

Read-only, per decision 030: every account change is a support request. Values are no longer set in micro-caption, which had been uppercasing the person's name and their permanent address.
Deletion has no in-app control. It is named and routed, because the consent instrument promises the right at signup and a promised right that cannot be found is worse than one never offered.

Seven mechanics now, not six. Nothing had told a worker that businesses place them on seven set measures, which travel with every grant and onto the public page — a person agreeing could not have known they were consenting to be ranked.
Row 5 was softened past accuracy: "You can dispute anything" promised a remedy the system does not provide. It now says what actually exists.

The identity core is dropped (DESIGN.md gap 11, closed by 029 §B6); the graticule clipped to the fixed canvas carries absence, with no boundary ring.
The copy previously promised "nothing is drawn until someone confirms it", which the next artboard breaks by drawing five unconfirmed chapters.

Transliteration is real now. The first build's comment claimed the field arrived prefilled and was never rejected; the code stripped to [a-z0-9-], which returns an empty string for a Devanagari or Arabic name and was then classed as invalid — on the screen where a person claims their own identity.
The error state thickens the rule and speaks in ink. It had made the rule paler and set the error quieter than the success.

Three statements here were false and are corrected: the closing line claimed every record was written by the parties named, directly above a self-asserted chapter; "this page shows what is true" claimed more than provenance supports; and a worker-typed job title was printed above "employment confirmed", so a reader concluded the employer had confirmed a supervisory role.
Registry state is now on every party, the mark uses its solid tier at 20px per §3, and the count is broken out instead of collapsing four kinds of evidence into "three attested".
NOT DRAWN: the reduced page a crawler or logged-out visitor gets, and the employer's grant view (gap 8).

NEW, decision 045. Sharing was the record's fourth section, below identity, outstanding verification and work history — which is where a product puts what does not matter, on the one surface where worker custody is actually exercised.
Exposure is stated in one sentence before any control: a worker learns what is already true before deciding anything. Every control is drawn but inert; what revoke and the visibility switches actually do is undecided (gaps 8 and 13).
The closing line on grants says ending one stops future reads and cannot pull back what was already read and kept, rather than implying otherwise.

Verification frames, not designs. Nothing here paints fake chrome — no clock, no battery, no home-bar glyph — because on a real device the system draws into exactly that space and an imitation renders doubled. The insets are drawn as empty reserved bands carrying their measurements.

What they show: iOS leaves 759 pt of 852 once the 59 pt status/Dynamic Island and 34 pt home indicator are taken. Android leaves 728 dp of 800 against a 24 dp status bar and 48 dp three-button navigation — the larger figure, because three-button nav still ships and users still choose it. Every screen in this repo is drawn 360x800, so the record is 41 pt too tall for iOS and 72 dp too tall for Android, and its header sits under the status bar at both ends.

design/08 §3 recorded this and nothing acted on it. Removing the plate footer made the bottom worse: scrollable content now runs to the edge where the gesture bar lives. Reflowing the ten screens is the next step and has not been done — these frames exist so it is decided against measurements rather than guesses.

Also unresolved and visible here: Android takes BOTH edges for the back gesture, and no screen draws a back affordance.
